attchmntText: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited submitted an investor presentation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 was 96.9 thousand crore rupees, a 34.0 percent year-on-year increase. Reported EBITDA margin was 6.2 percent. Profit before tax before exceptional items was 0.4 thousand crore rupees. Jaguar Land Rover reported revenue of 5.9 billion pounds with an adjusted EBIT margin of 1.1 percent. JLR wholesales reached 82.5 thousand units, up 20.3 percent year-on-year. Net debt for the consolidated group stood at 50.8 thousand crore rupees. JLR net debt was 50.8 billion pounds. The company unveiled the TATA.CARS brand identity and launched the Aeris sedan. Three new electric vehicles were introduced during the quarter.

attchmntText: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited approved Audited Standalone and Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Consolidated revenue stood at 96.9K Cr, up 34 percent year on year. EBITDA margin was 6.2 percent. Profit before tax excluding exceptional items was 0.4K Cr. Exceptional items totaled 6.7K Cr, comprising 3.8K Cr for employee separation costs and 2.9K Cr for asset impairment. Net profit after tax was negative 5.5K Cr. Free cash flow was negative 6.3K Cr. Net debt was 50.8K Cr as at September 30, 2026. Jaguar Land Rover revenue was 5.9 billion pounds, up 20.3 percent. Tata Passenger Vehicles revenue was 20.4K Cr, up 51 percent. The company revised full year guidance to an adjusted EBIT margin of 2 to 3 percent and free cash outflow of approximately 1.25 billion pounds.

attchmntText: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has intimated the National Stock Exchange regarding physical group meetings with analysts and institutional investors scheduled for November 18, 2026. The meetings are divided into three time slots. The first session is at 10:00 a.m. and includes Tata Asset Management Limited, Karma Capital Advisors Private Ltd, Taurus MF, Subhkam Ventures, FourLion Capital, Bandhan Life Insurance, and JM Financial Products Limited. The second session is at 12:00 Noon and features Baroda BNP Paribas Mutual Fund, Habrok Capital Management LLP, Nippon India Mutual Fund, Enam Holdings, UTI - NPS Trustee, Sundaram Alternate Assets Limited, IIFL Capital AMC, and Bandhan Mutual Fund. The third session is at 2:00 p.m. with Bandhan Mutual Fund, Kotak Mahindra Asset Management Co. Ltd, Aditya Birla Sun Life Mutual Fund, ASK PMS, 360 ONE Asset Management (PMS), and North Rock Capital. The final session is at 3:00 p.m. with UTI Asset Management Company Limited, Bajaj Life Insurance, Canara HSBC Life, HDFC Pension Management Company Ltd, and MAIQ Capital. The company notes that the schedule is subject to change.

attchmntText: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has revised the access link for its investor conference call regarding financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The call is scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, from 6:30 PM to 7:45 PM India Standard Time. The revision follows a reported outage on Microsoft platforms. Senior management, including Mr. Shailesh Chandra, Mr. P B Balaji, Mr. Dhiman Gupta, and Mr. Richard Molyneux, will participate. Participants can join via the webcast link at https://webstream.streamcart.com/live/tatamotors13112026. Questions may be submitted using the Q&A text box on the link during the call. The results and investor presentation will be uploaded to the company website at https://tata.cars/investors/overview.html on November 13, 2026, shortly after dissemination to stock exchanges.

attchmntText: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 52,771  Equity Shares.
voiceSummary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has allotted 52,771 equity shares of Rs. 2 each to eligible employees under the Share-based Long Term Incentive Scheme 2021. The allotment was approved by the Allotment Committee on November 12, 2026, following the exercise of 52,771 Performance Share Units at an exercise price of Rs. 2 per share. Consequently, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from Rs. 7,36,64,61,785 to Rs. 7,36,65,67,327. The total number of equity shares has risen from 3,68,29,92,140 to 3,68,30,44,911. These newly issued shares rank pari passu with existing equity shares in all respects. The company has intimated this disclosure to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
